size.small: One flow, 5 or fewer screens, 1 or 2 roles
size.large: Several flows, more than 5 screens, or 3 or more roles

handoff.must_be_able_to_do: Write tickets and build the HTML deliverable without coming back to the design team: every screen has its states, roles, permissions, edge cases and AI states defined, every component and token is in the design library or listed as a gap, feasibility limits and API and data assumptions are written down, and every rulebook break is either fixed or listed as a Ship note
handoff.does_not_include: Jira tickets, user stories, the engineer-facing HTML deliverable, production code or a pull request, and any user testing beyond what Explore did
